name: Popularisation of Fishery Machinery/Equipment/Implements for Intensive Aquaculture
eligibility_facts: registered members of Primary Fisherman Cooperative Society
hard_exclusions: same component subsidy in prior 5 years excludes that component
questions: What fishery equipment do you need?
Have you received subsidy for the same component in the last five years?
temporal_note: Source explicitly labels the scheme for FY 2021-22; verify current availability.

source_text_aliases: registered members of Primary Fisherman Cooperative Society

question.en: Are you an individual fish farmer or fisher, a registered Primary Fisherman Cooperative Society member, or a WSHG involved in fish or shrimp production?
question.or: ଆପଣ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ମାଛ ଚାଷୀ କିମ୍ବା ମତ୍ସ୍ୟଜୀବୀ, ପଞ୍ଜିକୃତ ପ୍ରାଥମିକ ମତ୍ସ୍ୟଜୀବୀ ସମବାୟ ସଦସ୍ୟ, କିମ୍ବା ମାଛ/ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ଉତ୍ପାଦନରେ ନିୟୋଜିତ WSHG କି?

description.en: The source describes a 40% back-ended subsidy; this is benefit information, not an eligibility question.
description.or: ଉତ୍ସରେ ୪୦% ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସବସିଡି ବର୍ଣ୍ଣିତ; ଏହା ଲାଭ ସୂଚନା, ଯୋଗ୍ୟତା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ନୁହେଁ।
